Subject: Redwood evaluation — quick recap & proposed kickoff times

Hi Michael,

Great to meet you and Tom on the call earlier — appreciate you walking us through Finlytics' ingestion pipeline and the primary evaluation goals. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're aligned: 

1) Goal: Validate model quality for customer support summarization and triage routing on Finlytics' historical ticket set (first proof point).
2) Success criteria (initial):
   - Average ROUGE/L-based similarity >= 0.75 on the curated prompt set
   - Median generation latency <= 350ms at 1k QPS equivalent for 1k-token context
   - No PII leakage on synthetic spot checks
3) Proposed kickoff / evaluation plan (attached): trial plan, data/ingest checklist, and an initial prompt set we can run as part of the evaluation.

Next step: schedule a 60-minute evaluation kickoff (technical deep dive + trial plan alignment). Proposed times (PT):
- Tue May 3, 9:00–10:00am PT
- Tue May 3, 2:00–3:00pm PT
- Wed May 4, 10:00–11:00am PT

Can you confirm which works for you and whether we should include your CTO/lead engineer (Tom?) and any SRE involved in data access? I’ve attached the v2 eval plan for reference. If you prefer, you can pick a slot on my calendar: https://calendly.com/redwood/neha-eval-kickoff

Attachments: Redwood-Eval-Plan-v2.pdf, SOW-template.docx

Thanks — looking forward to kicking this off.

Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Perfect — I've booked Tue May 3, 2:00–3:00pm PT on the calendar and sent a calendar invite to everyone (invite includes the meeting agenda).

Quick responses to your asks: 
- Data artifacts checklist: attached to the invite and included in the Eval Plan PDF (summary below):
  • 1 exported sample of historical tickets (CSV) — 1k–5k rows, columns: ticket_id, created_at, user_text, agent_text, metadata (json).
  • Access method: S3 pre-signed URL or secure file transfer (we prefer S3).
  • A sample of any internal prompt templates you use for summaries.
- NDA/PO: we don't require a separate NDA for the evaluation (we'll operate under the standard partner eval terms). If procurement needs a PO to approve the pilot spend for Dedicated/Private later, our sales ops team can coordinate — I've attached the SOW-template for reference.

Prep requests for the kickoff (to help make the 60 minutes actionable):
- Finlytics success criteria (one-paragraph) to validate during kickoff — if you can drop this in the thread before Tue, we’ll align the test bed accordingly.
- Example prompt set (5–10 prompts) or two sample tickets to use as a quick demo during the call. We can then expand the prompt set during week 1 of the trial.

Agenda (attached to invite):
- 5m intros and goals
- 15m architecture & data access review (Priya + SRE)
- 25m trial plan & evaluation metrics (Neha + Marissa)
- 10m immediate next steps & ownership

See you Tue at 2pm PT — I’ll include a short shared Drive link with the prompt template after this email.

Best,
Neha
